name: MKX 1 Gram 510 Thread 15pk Carts - Autumn 2025 15pk
description: Experience the Flavors of Fall - The Autumn 2025 510 Cart 15-Pack is a curated collection of five distinctive strains, each hand-picked to capture the richness of fall! Classics like Apple Fritter, Blueberry Afgoo, and Lavender Diesel return with their familiar depth and are joined by a smooth all-new strain called Cake Batter, as well as the limited-edition pack exclusive strain: Cherry Pie. Consumers can explore each strain and vote for which they think best defines autumn via the QR Code located inside of the box. Voting is open until December 1st, 2025!
